title: The Heavy Basket of Kindling
youtube_title: The Heavy Basket of Kindling | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Kindness is helping carry what feels too heavy.
summary: At a cottage porch and the hall just inside, a basket of kindling that kept tipping is awkward for one person. Dahlia notices Cousin Pio struggling and takes a useful half of the job without asking to be praised.
